title: How do you feel today?
objectives: express feelings and emotions using to be + adjective
ask partners about their current emotional state

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for How do you feel today?.
Welcome to today's lesson: How do you feel today?! Today we will practice how to express feelings and emotions using to be + adjective.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for How do you feel today?:
express feelings and emotions using to be + adjective; ask partners about their current emotional state

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: fine, happy, sad, tired, nice, good

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Complete: 'My brother worked all day and now he is ___.'

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: Hello! I am feeling very happy today. My sister is sad, but my brother is fine.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
How do you feel today? I am happy and fine. My brother is tired after work, but he is good.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Ask your teacher and classmates how they feel today and share your own feelings.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: express feelings and emotions using to be + adjective, ask partners about their current emotional state.
